messages:
Sam H: Heads-up — two docs PRs need quick ownership so we can hit tomorrow's merge window (10:00 PT). One is an SDK snippet fix (tiny) and the other is a migration guide that needs example validation.
Priya K: I can pick up the SDK snippet. which PR number? :+1:
Sam H: PR #4123 — it's basically a language mismatch in the Python snippet and missing a small import. Should be a 5-min fix but needs a reviewer for the final wording.
Evelyn (Docs): Thanks, Priya. For the migration guide (PR #4117) we need someone to sanity-check the example outputs and the commands. The examples were generated on a newer runtime so a few CLI flags might differ.
Noah L: I can look at #4117 after stand — can run the examples locally. Might need environment hints from infra.
Sam H: Awesome. Two notes:
- If running locally, use the preview command: `yarn docs:preview --pr 4117` (it spins up a netlify-like preview)
- CI docs-preview has been flaky; InfraBot, any idea on the build flakiness logs?
InfraBot: build/4117-preview failed on step "mkdocs build" — error: missing requirement `redwood-infer` in venv. Logs: https://ci.redwood/test/4117/logs
Priya K: I hit the same earlier — I run `python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt` then `yarn docs:preview`. Also watch for the env var `MODEL_ENDPOINT` in the migration examples.
Noah L: running now. If I see endpoint mismatch I'll stub with a local mock and note it in the PR.
Evelyn (Docs): Quick reviewer guidance to keep reviews short:
- SDK snippet: check imports, one-liner example runs, and minor wording.
- Migration guide: validate commands, example outputs, and add a short note if a flag changed (don't rewrite whole guide).
Sam H: Can we get both merged before 10:00 PT tomorrow? If any blocking CI flakes, assign to the oncall reviewer to escalate.
Priya K: I'll aim to merge #4123 by EOD today. If CI flakes, I'll request a manual preview from infra.
Noah L: I expect #4117 will take ~30-45 mins. If it's longer I'll post a status update here.
Evelyn (Docs): If either of you hit capacity, tag `@docs-oncall` — rotation today is @Jana and @micah.
Sam H: Noted. Also, lightweight checklist to paste into the PR description if helpful:
```
- [ ] Example code runs locally
- [ ] Outputs match or explain diffs
- [ ] CLI flags documented
- [ ] No broken links (run `yarn linkcheck`)
```
Priya K: Pasted checklist into #4123.
Noah L: Found one mismatch in an example output — will add a short note and push a tiny correction.
InfraBot: build/4123-preview succeeded. Preview URL: https://previews.redwood/4123
Sam H: Great — Priya, if preview is green feel free to merge when ready.
Priya K: Merged #4123 (clean CI). :tada:
Noah L: Updated #4117 with a corrected example and a note about the `--compact` flag behavior. Ran `yarn linkcheck` — clean. Requesting review from @Evelyn.
Evelyn (Docs): Reviewing now.
Sam H: Thanks everyone. Quick postmortem note: Infra, can we add `redwood-infer` to the docs CI venv to reduce flakes? Filing a follow-up issue.
InfraBot: Issue created: INFRA-889 (add docs CI dependency). https://issues.redwood/INFRA-889
Evelyn (Docs): Both PRs merged and changelog updated. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
